title: Sinseeker Scythe
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Weapon |id = SINSEEKER_SCYTHE |rarity = Epic |dungeon_level_requirement = {{Skl|catacombs|23}} (when dungeonized) |slayer_level_requirement = Enderman Slayer 6 |damage = +100 |strength = +100 |raw_materials = *4096 Null Sphere *163,840 Obsidian *16 Null Atom *1 Sinful Dice |bazaar_not_including = [[Sinful Dice]] |reforge = Yes |auctionable = Yes |enchant = Yes |museum = y |museum_xp = 7 |museum_category = combat |mat_cost_bazaar=*4096 NULL_SPHERE *1024 Enchanted Obsidian *32 NULL_ATOM}} The '''Sinseeker Scythe''' is an {{Epic}} [[Swords|Sword]] unlocked at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer VI}}. Its ability teleports the player, then recalls them and damages all enemies along the path. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 6}} |A1 = Null Atom, 4 |B1 = Null Ovoid, 8 |C1 = Null Atom, 4 |A2 = Null Ovoid, 8 |B2 = Sinful Dice |C2 = Null Ovoid, 8 |A3 = Null Atom, 4 |B3 = Null Ovoid, 8 |C3 = Null Atom, 4 |Output = Sinseeker Scythe }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |rarity = epic |damage = 100 |strength = 100 |item_ability_name = Sinrecall Transmission |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Zap a line {{Purple|4}} blocks forward.

Recast within 1s ({{Cyan|1.5x Mana}}) or warp back to starting point.

Mobs crossing the line(s) receive a {{Red|melee hit}} from what you're holding. |item_ability_mana_cost = 260 }} When the ability is used, it teleports the player 4 blocks forward, leaving behind a red line. For every time the ability is recast within 1 second, its {{Stat|mana cost}} increases by 1.5x. If the ability is not recast within 1 second, the user will be teleported back to where they started. All enemies in contact with the red line(s) receive a melee hit from the weapon the user holds. Its ability can be upgraded with {{Item|Transmission Tuner}}s. == Essence Crafting == This weapon can be upgraded with Dragon Essence. Once upgraded, it requires {{Skill|Catacombs|23}} to use. {{Essence Crafting |70 |140 |210 |350 |600 |convert = 250 |essence = Dragon |type = weapon }} == Trivia == * This item can be used to achieve very fast completions for [[Races]] if the user has enough {{Stat|Mana}} to be able to continuously use its {{AN|Sinrecall Transmission}} ability. * The '''Sinseeker Scythe''' is often used for obtaining [[Dungeon Secrets]] faster, because it can be used to quickly teleport forward and backward, saving time. * If one gets low on {{stat|health}} in combat, the '''Sinseeker Scythe''' can be useful as it can mark the current location before dying and teleport to the location after dying. == Gallery == Sinseeker Scythe (in hand).png|In-hand model. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Sinseeker Scythe (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Sinseeker Scythe''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|2021/May 25|link=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z6vjrwQ1hlY|{{RN|mvp+|Minikloon}} leaks the '''Sinseeker Scythe''' and its ability.}} {{History|2021/May 31|[[File:Sinseeker Scythe (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Sinseeker Scythe'''.}} {{History|unknown|Fixed {{Item|Transmission Tuner}} not working with this item.}} {{history|2023/Aug 8|{{AN|Sinrecall Transmission}} now cancels when the player teleports due to some other reason.}} {{history|2023/Aug 15|Fixed being able to use {{AN|Sinrecall Transmission}} in the {{Zone|Jungle Temple}}.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Sinseeker Scythe (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Sinseeker Scythe''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Enderman}}
